tiers.ability_description: At the end of each turn, Tank allies recover Health and Protection equal to 50% of the amount enemies recovered that turn. This recovery can't trigger this effect on enemies.
Healer allies start the battle with Damage Immunity for 2 turns (can't be copied).
At the start of their first turn, Attacker allies gain Offense equal to 400% of their current Defense until the end of battle. Then they lose 50% Defense until the end of battle.
The first time each Healer ally falls below 50% Health they gain Damage Immunity for 1 turn and gain Health Steal Up for 2 turns.
Whenever Dark Side allies use a Basic ability, they gain Critical Chance Up, Critical Damage Up, and Offense Up for 2 turns.
Whenever a First Order ally has full Health and Protection at the start of their turn, they deal +100% more Damage on their turn.
At the start of the encounter, the weakest ally gains 20% Turn Meter for every Light Side ally.
